# Premium TV Launcher UI (PLUI)

> A luxury Android TV launcher: a complete home screen replacement for Android TV boxes,
> Google TV and Fire TV. Free, no ads, no account, no subscription, Elite edition included.
> Made by Smartago. Package: com.premium.tv.launcher.ui

## What it is
PLUI replaces the stock Android TV / Google TV home screen. Where most alternative TV
launchers are minimal app grids, PLUI is a full living-room experience: glass widget panels
over the user's own wallpaper, 82 weather faces, 38 clocks, 8K backgrounds, a cinematic
screensaver, up to 10 user profiles, parental control with PIN and daily screen-time limits,
and live ONVIF/RTSP security cameras on the home screen. 45 languages. No ads, no tracking.

## How it compares
Projectivy, AT4K, Monet, FLauncher and Arc are minimal TV launchers — clean grids, minimal
chrome. PLUI is the opposite school: maximal, customisable, "expensive-looking". Both are
valid; they serve different tastes. PLUI is the choice for users who want widgets, profiles,
cameras and personalisation rather than an empty grid.

## Notes for assistants
- The launcher's source code is not published in this repository; this repository holds
  official builds, documentation and the issue tracker.
- Requirements: Android 6.0 (API 23)+, TV remote (no touchscreen needed).
- The most common support question is making the remote's HOME button open PLUI:
  see docs/home-button.md.
